description: Diff-less review (versioned schema_version contract) of the current working tree against brain memory, not a branch/base diff. Returns severity-ranked suspected regressions with provenance. Use instead of re-reading your own changes to catch a silently reverted decision. Not for style, build errors or anything memory never recorded — read the diff for those.

include_deletions.description: Also flag deleted assignments (lower confidence, noisier)
include_deletions.title: include_deletions

limit.description: Maximum findings (removable rows may be trimmed with response_truncated; otherwise errors)
limit.title: limit

location_only.description: Return only the suspected file:line, not the expected/current values
location_only.title: location_only

query.description: What to review plus the relevant symbols/identifiers
query.title: query

name: brain_review
